description: Accessibility hardening, final polish, and full integration verification. Add missing aria-labels to any remaining icon-only buttons not covered in FEAT-002, verify focus ring visibility in both dark and light themes, confirm reduced-motion media query works, and do a complete cross-page visual and functional audit. This FEAT is independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 in terms of what it adds, but runs after both to catch anything missed.
steps: 0. Read context.json at D:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\.agents\tasks\ui-cleanup-task\context.json and the plan at d:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\medfusion-ai\.agents\tasks\ui-cleanup-plan.md.

1. Run a grep/search across all src/ JSX files for remaining 'animate-pulse' usages. For each hit: if it is on a spinner/loading indicator — keep it (that is functional). If it is on a static decorative icon in a non-loading context — remove the class.

2. Run a grep/search for remaining 'textShadow' in JSX inline styles. Remove any textShadow with rgba(...,0.1x) or 'var(--theme-accent-glow)' values — these are glow effects. Leave any textShadow used for legitimate text legibility (e.g., white text on light background).

3. Run a grep/search for remaining inline 'boxShadow' values containing '0 0 ' (zero-offset glow shadows). Evaluate each: if it's a structural elevation shadow (positive offset like 0 4px 12px) — keep it. If it's a zero-offset neon glow (0 0 Xpx rgba(color,alpha)) — remove or replace with structural shadow.
4. Verify src/index.css contains no remaining 'backdrop-filter: blur(15px)' or higher values outside of the nav and modal (which are intentionally kept at 6px and 3px).

5. Check src/App.jsx Navbar component: verify theme toggle button has aria-label (it does from original — confirm not removed). Verify NavLink active state uses CSS class not inline style for the active indicator.

6. Check src/pages/NearbyMap.jsx: read the file. Apply same cleanup pattern (remove animate-pulse from decorative icons, remove textShadow glow, remove boxShadow glow inline styles). Do NOT touch Leaflet map logic, geolocation API calls, marker rendering, filter controls. The leaflet backdrop-filter reset in index.css (.leaflet-container *) must remain intact.

7. Check src/components/VoiceExplainer.jsx and src/components/InteractiveMap.jsx: read each file. Apply same cleanup pattern if glow/animate-pulse patterns exist. Do NOT touch audio/speech API logic or map integration logic.
8. Check src/pages/GuestUpload.jsx: read the file. If it is a thin wrapper around Upload.jsx — no changes needed. If it has its own upload UI — apply same cleanup as FEAT-002 Item 7 (Upload.jsx).
9. Check src/pages/Dashboard.jsx: read the file — it is likely a thin router that delegates to PatientDashboard/DoctorDashboard/GuestDashboard. Confirm no glow styles live there directly.

10. Final accessibility audit across all modified files: (a) Every <button> that contains only an icon (no visible text) must have aria-label. (b) Every <input type='range'> must have aria-label. (c) Every form <input> must have an associated <label>. (d) Every interactive <div onClick=...> that is not inside a real button must have role, tabIndex, and onKeyDown for keyboard nav.
11. Verify the @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block in index.css correctly suppresses all animations when the user's OS has reduced motion enabled.
12. Verify dark/light theme toggle still works end-to-end: ThemeContext sets data-theme on <html>, CSS [data-theme='light'] overrides activate, nav background changes, glass cards switch to white.
13. Run npm run lint. Fix any lint errors introduced across all 3 FEATs.
14. Run npm run build. Confirm 0 errors. Record final CSS and JS bundle sizes in findings.
15. Create a git commit with message 'refactor: accessibility hardening and final cleanup audit (FEAT-003)'.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes with 0 errors
npm run lint completes with 0 errors
No remaining animate-pulse on non-loading-state icons (grep result is empty or only loading spinners)
No remaining zero-offset neon glow box-shadows in inline JSX styles
No remaining textShadow glow on accent text in JSX inline styles
Every icon-only <button> has an aria-label attribute
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block exists and is syntactically valid in index.css
Dark/light theme toggle still switches the UI theme correctly
